data.notes_tail: 1's two X-ray sections duplicate each other with generic items, an answered-elsewhere case the detector misses when NEITHER section has a table; 3875's 'What to Expect During Your Visit' is 561 chars of prose plus a phone number. Held not cut: 3825 dog-bite closure (good content, but the decision is the doctor's), and 3977/3091/3803/3365 process sections on posts already carrying 3+ cards. make.mjs enforces that `subject` appear in the card's visible text, so subject must be a word on the card.
